objective: Design and implement the Equipment System including data models, ScriptableObjects, runtime equip manager, and integration with combat and card systems.
prerequisites: Existing ScriptableObject base classes from Phase2

steps.title: Define data model
steps.description: Review and extend equipment.schema.json. Choose stable id format and shape for statModifiers and cardModifiers.

steps.title: Create C# data models
steps.description: Add POCO classes under Assets/Scripts/DataModels/Equipment/ with [Serializable] and enums for Rarity and SlotType.

steps.title: Implement ScriptableObject representations
steps.description: Create EquipmentDefinition ScriptableObject and author CreateAssetMenu for editor usability.

steps.title: Implement EquipmentManager service
steps.description: Provide equip/unequip, slot validation, stat aggregation and IEquipmentService interface.

steps.title: Integrate card modifiers
steps.description: Define cardModifier contract and apply modifiers during card effect resolution.

steps.title: Acquisition and persistence
steps.description: Hook into loot and merchant systems; ensure meta persistence and optional run snapshot representation.

steps.title: Tests and validation
steps.description: Unit tests for aggregation and enforcement; schema compliance tests for equipment JSON assets.

notes: Use enums to mirror schema enums.
Prefer ScriptableObjects for editing; reuse JSON import tool to create these assets.
Keep cardModifiers small typed objects to simplify application during effect resolution.
